sentences.en: She has on a pretty red dress.

sentences.en: The only bait he could find was a bright red blossom from a flower; but he knew fishes are easy to fool if anything bright attracts their attention, so he decided to try the blossom.

sentences.en: Stout, about the average height, broad, with huge red hands; he did not know, as the saying is, how to enter a drawing room and still less how to leave one; that is, how to say something particularly agreeable before going away.
sentences.vi: Mập mạp, chiều cao trung bình, rộng, với bàn tay to màu đỏ; anh ta không biết, như người ta nói, làm thế nào để vào một phòng vẽ và vẫn ít hơn làm thế nào để rời khỏi một phòng; nghĩa là, làm thế nào để nói điều gì đó đặc biệt hợp ý trước khi đi xa.

sentences.en: I have laughed at the poor duck, with the red rag tied round its leg.

sentences.en: What she expected to see when she turned was Sarah's white Plymouth, but the car that stopped before the house was Allen's red Eagle Talon.
